title: S³LoRA: Safe Spectral Sharpness–Guided Pruning in Adaptation of Agent Planner
reasoning: The paper focuses on a pruning framework (S³LoRA) to enhance the safety and efficiency of LoRA-adapted LLM agents. While it evaluates model 'Harmfulness' using GPT-4 scores and 'Attack Success Rate' (ASR), it does not specifically benchmark religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or formal ethical systems.
